resources.string: Step %1$d/%2$d
How do I…?
Choose what you want to do. We will guide you through the real screens, one step at a time. You can close or collapse the tip at any point.
Show guide
Collapse explanation
Show explanation
Exit guide
Got it
Complete this step on the screen, then tap Next. Use the arrow to collapse this tip if needed.
Create my own playlist
Start with a video or song, choose a name and create your collection. You can add more items later.
Find music
Search for a song or artist in your enabled sources and choose what to play.
Play music in random order
Shuffle a local playlist. You need at least one playlist; if you do not have one yet, use the playlist creation guide first.
Find an artist’s album
Albums are often available as playlists. Learn how to search for them and open their tracks; results depend on the enabled sources.
Download a video or song
Save content to watch or listen without a connection. Choose audio only or video, when the source supports downloads.
Follow a YouTube channel
Follow a channel in Grayjoy to find its new videos in Home and Following. This is local to the app and does not itself change your YouTube account.
Search for the first video or song to add. Type in the search box and press Search on the keyboard. You can choose any result.
Touch and hold the video you want to add. Its action menu opens; then tap Next here.
In the video menu, tap Add to playlist. Then tap Next to create your own.
Tap New playlist if shown, enter a name and press Create. The video will be added. Find it in Library → Playlists, and repeat Add to playlist to add more songs.
Enter a song title or artist and press Search on the keyboard. If there are no results, check your connection. To enable a platform, open Prefs → Sources.
Tap the result you want to hear to open the player. If you are on another results tab, choose Videos.
Control the music from the player. Pause it or drag the player down to keep browsing while listening. Return to Search to choose something else.
Open the playlist you want to hear. If the list is empty, exit this guide and use Create my own playlist first.
Enable the crossed-arrows button. When highlighted, the playlist plays in random order. Then tap Next.
Tap Play all to shuffle the playlist. Turn off the crossed arrows when you prefer the usual order.
Enter the artist and album name (or add the word album), then press Search on the keyboard.
Tap Playlists in the results and wait for them to load. If there are no albums, try a more specific title or a source that supports them.
Tap the album or playlist you want to see its tracks.
Here are the album tracks. Tap Play all or choose a track to start with.
Search for the content you want to save and press Search on the keyboard. Downloading requires a connection and free device storage.
Tap Download below the player. Scroll the row of buttons if it is out of view. Some sources do not support downloads.
Choose Audio for just the song, or Video, then confirm with Download. Follow progress in Active jobs and find the file in Library → Downloads. If it is already downloaded, do not press Remove.
Search for the channel name or one of its videos and press Search on the keyboard. You can enable YouTube in Prefs → Sources.
Tap the channel name and picture below a YouTube result to open the creator’s page.
Tap Follow. If it already says Following, you already follow this channel in Grayjoy. Find new videos in Home → Subscriptions and in Following.
